$comment: Single source of truth for the hosted demo's public routes.
Consumed by two gates that check the same routes at different layers:
- frontend/e2e/demo-smoke.spec.ts  — renders each route in the local
`serve dist` preview and asserts content + zero console errors.
- scripts/checks/check_prod_surfaces.mjs — probes the DEPLOYED site and
asserts each route is served by the demo shell, not the marketing one.
Both must read this file. They historically disagreed: the local preview
frontend/public/_redirects, so a broken _redirects rule kept every deep
link green locally while production served the landing page.
`marker` is a case-insensitive regex SOURCE string (not a literal), matched
inside <main> by the Playwright spec. Adding a route here adds it to both
gates; keep it in step with the <Route> table in frontend/src/App.tsx.
